head: ai-replay-budget-r3
report:
NO DEFECTS

I'm asserting no defects at eef64a4f. I rebuilt the earlier round's probes against this head, and every earlier finding they cover is now closed. I didn't find a new defect I could prove. Coverage is limited: the diff is about 6,900 lines across 17 provider files plus `fetch-retry`, and in the 20 minutes I read the core files closely but only skimmed the per-provider changes.

## NOT A DEFECT

**Earlier findings, replayed at this head.** I copied the earlier reviewer's `send-gaps.test.ts` and `adversarial.test.ts` to my scratch directory and linked the snapshot's `node_modules` there. Run from `packages/ai`, they gave 73 pass and 1 fail. The one failure is the test that expected a never-settling wait hook to stay pending, which is the earlier bug, so it now fails because the bug is fixed.

| Earlier finding | Status | What I measured at this head |
|---|---|---|
| 1. Request sent after the deadline: a slow outer-attempt preparation hook (completions, Azure Responses) | **Closed** | `prepares:2`. Completions sent 1 request and Azure sent 6, all inside the first attempt. No request went out after the 900 ms hook. Marked in both. |
| 1. Request sent after the deadline: the Codex outgoing diagnostic observer blocks for 900 ms | **Closed** | `observes:2`, 1 request reached the server, marked. |
| 2. A shorter header beats a longer one (`retry-after-ms: 1` with `retry-after: 30`, and the three-header case) | **Closed** | All 8 HTTP lanes sent 1 request and marked it. `headerRetryHints` now reads every header and every comma-separated value. |
| 2. Repeated body hints, or a malformed first hint followed by a valid one | **Closed** | 1 request, marked, on all 8 lanes. The body parser now reads every occurrence of each phrase when a retry gate is set. |
| 2. `x-ratelimit-reset-after` ignored | **Closed** | `longestRetryHint` now reads it. |
| 2. Responses reasoning correction ignores `retry-after: 30` | **Closed** | `hinted-correction`: 1 send, marked. |
| 3. Vertex regional 404 falls back to the global endpoint with budget 0 | **Closed** | `vertex-zero-fallback`: 1 URL requested, marked. |
| Overrunning wait: a hook that never settles held the call indefinitely | **Closed** | My own probe (`prior/neverwait.test.ts`, budget 600 ms, hook never released, no abort): Anthropic settled at 624.9 ms, Cursor at 611.5 ms, completions at 519.9 ms, all marked. `ReplayBudget.wait` now races the hook against the deadline and the caller's signal. |
| Earlier round's own closures (unconditional first resume GET; marker set when the provider's own correction limit stopped the call) | Still closed | No change in this diff reopens them. |

The controls still behave as before: different body grammars, a malformed header beside a valid one, a long header with a short body, and hinted 401s that are neither retried nor marked. The queued and blocking custom-transport cases still write after the deadline. The new documentation explicitly places those outside the guarantee.

**Suspicions I checked and ruled out:**
- **One budget per call.** I checked whether the auth-retry layer and the provider could end up with separate budgets and deadlines. `withTransportFetch` attaches the budget to the options, `streamSimpleRequest` reads it back from those options, and `mapOptionsForApi`/`stream()` pass the same budget on. The auth layer and the provider share one deadline.
- **A fetch that is already wrapped skips the deadline check.** Only internal re-entries pass an already-wrapped fetch, and they carry the same budget. `compaction/bedrock.ts` and `connection-prewarm.ts` call `transportFetch` outside any streaming call.
- **The held-retry change in `turn-recovery.ts`.** The new `sameModelWaitMs < 2000` condition could stop the same-model hold from ever being taken. It doesn't: `retry.baseDelayMs` defaults to 500, so the first backoff stays well under 2 s. Walking the fallback chain when the server asks for a longer wait is what the changelog says.
- **Nothing in coding-agent reads `replayBudgetExhausted`.** Failover still works without it. After a budget-limited held retry, `#retryAttempt` is 2, so `#isFirstAttemptMidStreamSocketDrop` returns false and the chain is consulted.
- **Copilot identity and compression resends with an unread denial body.** `isCopilotIdentityDenied` and `bodyText` read clones, so a denial returned after a refusal can still be read. Refusing these resends when the budget is 0 is documented as intended.
- **Leftover pending checks from `admits`.** `admits` sets up a deadline check that nothing may consume when retrying stops after an admission. In the paths I traced, no further request goes out in that call, so I found no consumer it could affect.
- **Thinking-loop re-sample refused before sending.** `onAttempt` is called with the refused attempt's message before the earlier stall is returned. I found no caller that this measurably breaks, so I'm not claiming it as a defect.

**Not run:** the repository-wide typecheck and full suites (unavailable here), the end-to-end coding-agent session probe, and the coding-agent suite failures the earlier round reported (image fallback, HUD and others). Whether those are related to this change is still open.
